exercises.prompt: What is the command for the empty set symbol $\emptyset$?
exercises.explanation: `\emptyset` renders $\emptyset$; a common alternative is `\varnothing`, a slightly different glyph preferred by some style guides.

exercises.prompt: Which command correctly typesets the complex conjugate $\bar{z}$ (a straight bar over the variable)?
exercises.explanation: `\bar` draws a flat overline (conjugates, means); `\hat` draws a caret (estimators, unit vectors); `\vec` draws an arrow (vectors); `\tilde` draws a squiggle (approximation, equivalence) — each is a visually distinct accent command.

exercises.prompt: Write the LaTeX source for this set-builder notation, matching this target exactly: $$\{x \in \mathbb{R} : x > 0\}$$ Work it out, then reveal and compare.
exercises.explanation: Curly braces are special grouping characters in LaTeX, so literal set braces need escaping as `\{` and `\}`; `\in` gives the membership symbol and `\mathbb{R}` gives the blackboard-bold reals.
